text: 中国证监会10月9日宣布，就《公开募集证券投资基金运作管理办法（征求意见稿）》及配套规则公开征求意见。征求意见稿支持权益类基金发展，拟将权益类基金、基金中基金（FOF）等产品的成立门槛，从规模2亿元、份额2亿份，分别降至5000万元、5000万份，固收类基金成立门槛维持不变。（新华社）
text_en: The CSRC announced on October 9 that it is publicly soliciting comments on the Measures for the Operation and Management of Publicly Offered Securities Investment Funds (Draft for Comment) and supporting rules. The draft for comment supports the development of equity funds and proposes lowering the establishment thresholds for products such as equity funds and funds of funds (FOFs) from RMB 200 million and 200 million units to RMB 50 million and 50 million units, respectively, while the establishment threshold for fixed-income funds remains unchanged. (Xinhua News Agency)
